decisions.reason: The deliverable cancellation does not entail a value or scope modification to the historical audio-mixing specification; any lifecycle handling must not be encoded as a propagated MODIFY.
The preview workflow had already been executed, and cancellation of the overall deliverable does not alter its recorded workflow values or scope.
Leaving the task does not replace or invalidate any specific creative-concept attribute; it is a lifecycle decision rather than a candidate value or scope change.
The source does not change any keyword, claim, prohibited-term, or messaging rule and therefore does not support a propagated MODIFY.
The task cancellation does not resolve or modify the candidate's footage-method values or existing production-method ambiguity.
The source terminates the deliverable but does not revise the conversion objective, CPL target, creative priority, or scope.
A same-message MODIFY already records the 12-hour delivery window and leave-task consequence, and no additional value removal or scope change is entailed.
The source contains no change to the required hook approach, attention goal, or Indian-market fit; cancellation alone does not support a propagated MODIFY.
